q:
Cloze Test (1/5): Select the most appropriate option for Blank No. 1.

'The recent (1)______ in non-performing assets (NPAs) has caused significant (2)______ among public sector banks. Experts suggest that the (3)______ of credit appraisal processes is the need of the hour. While the government has proposed (4)______ measures, the long-term solution lies in structural reforms. Failure to address this could (5)______ the stability of the entire financial ecosystem.'
e: Blank 1: बैंकिंग संदर्भ में NPAs के बढ़ने (Escalation) की बात की जा रही है, जो चिंता का विषय है।

q: Error Spotting (1/5): Had the central bank (A) / not intervened in time (B) / the currency value (C) / would have plummeted further (D).
e: No Error: यह Third Conditional का Inversion structure है (Had + Sub + V3... would have + V3), जो पूरी तरह सही है।

q: Error Spotting (2/5): Not only the (A) / inflation rate increased (B) / but also the (C) / purchasing power decreased (D).
e: Inversion Rule: जब 'Not only' से वाक्य शुरू हो, तो 'Not only did the inflation rate increase' होना चाहिए।

q: Error Spotting (3/5): Neither the (A) / Finance Minister nor (B) / the Ministry officials (C) / was able to explain the deficit (D).
e: Proximity Rule: 'Neither-nor' में verb पास वाले subject (officials - Plural) के अनुसार 'were' होनी चाहिए।

q: Error Spotting (4/5): The interest rates (A) / offered by this (B) / bank is much higher (C) / than any other bank (D).
e: Subject-Verb Agreement: मुख्य subject 'rates' (Plural) है, इसलिए 'is' की जगह 'are' आएगा।

q: Error Spotting (5/5): Scarcely had the (A) / new policy been (B) / announced than (C) / the market crashed (D).
e: Correlative Rule: 'Scarcely' के साथ हमेशा 'when' लगता है, 'than' नहीं।

q: Sentence Improvement: The company's profits *have been falling down* for three consecutive quarters.
e: Redundancy: 'Fall' के साथ 'down' अनावश्यक है यदि संदर्भ केवल घटने का है। 'Falling' पर्याप्त है।

q: Sentence Improvement: No sooner *the manager saw* the error than he called for a meeting.
e: Inversion: 'No sooner' के तुरंत बाद auxiliary verb (had/did) का आना अनिवार्य है।

q: Sentence Improvement: Most of the employees *prefer working from home than* commuting to the office.
e: 'Prefer' के साथ हमेशा 'to' preposition का प्रयोग होता है, 'than' का नहीं।

q: Sentence Improvement: He is *the most intelligent* of all other students in the class.
e: Superlative Rule: जब 'all' का प्रयोग हो, तो 'other' को हटा दिया जाता है क्योंकि 'most intelligent' में वह स्वयं भी शामिल है।

q: Sentence Improvement: The board meeting *was postponed because of* the chairman was ill.
e: 'Because of' के बाद noun/phrase आता है, जबकि 'Because' या 'As' के बाद पूरा clause (chairman was ill) आता है।

q: Synonym of 'ABSTRUSE':
e: 'Abstruse' का अर्थ है जिसे समझना कठिन हो (गूढ़/Obscure)।

q: Synonym of 'PERSPICACIOUS':
e: 'Perspicacious' का अर्थ है बहुत गहरी समझ वाला (Astute/Shrewd)।

q: Antonym of 'ALACRITY':
e: 'Alacrity' (तत्परता) का उल्टा 'Lethargy' (सुस्ती/आलस) है।

q: Antonym of 'PUNITIVE':
e: 'Punitive' (दंडात्मक) का उल्टा 'Rewarding' (पुरस्कार देने वाला) होता है।

q: One-word Substitution: A situation where no progress is possible; a deadlock.
e: 'Impasse' का अर्थ है ऐसी स्थिति जहाँ से आगे बढ़ना असंभव हो (गतिरोध)।

q: One-word Substitution: One who makes an official examination of accounts.
e: खातों की आधिकारिक जांच करने वाले को 'Auditor' (लेखा परीक्षक) कहते हैं।

q: Idiom: 'To cook the books' means:
o: To write a book on cooking
e: बैंकिंग परीक्षाओं में यह प्रचलित है, इसका अर्थ है खातों में हेराफेरी करना।

q: Idiom: 'In the red' means:
o: To be in debt or losing money
e: 'In the red' का अर्थ है वित्तीय नुकसान में होना या कर्ज में होना।

q: Active/Passive: The bank manager has sanctioned the loan.
o: The loan was sanctioned by bank manager
The loan has been sanctioned by the bank manager
e: Present Perfect 'has + V3' बदलकर 'has been + V3' हो जाता है।

q: Active/Passive: Why did you decline the credit card offer?
o: Why was the credit card offer declined by you?
Why is the credit card offer declined?
Why had the offer been declined?
e: Simple Past Interrogative (did) बदलकर 'was/were + V3' में जाता है।

q: Active/Passive: Please maintain a minimum balance.
o: A minimum balance should be maintain
You are requested to maintain a minimum balance
e: 'Please' वाले वाक्यों में 'You are requested to' सबसे सटीक passive form है।

q: Direct/Indirect: The manager said to the clerk, 'Verify these documents at once.'
o: The manager told clerk verify documents
The manager ordered the clerk to verify those documents at once
The manager said to verify documents
e: Imperative (Order) में 'Ordered' और 'these' बदलकर 'those' हो जाता है।

q: Direct/Indirect: He said, 'The bank rate remains unchanged.'
o: He said that the bank rate remained unchanged
He said that the bank rate remains unchanged
He told bank rate is same
e: Fact/Information: चूँकि यह एक वर्तमान समाचार या तथ्य है, tense अक्सर unchanged रहता है, या 'remained' भी व्याकरणिक रूप से सही हो सकता है (विकल्प B यहाँ सूचनात्मक है)।

q: Direct/Indirect: 'Are you interested in the SIP plan?' the agent asked.
o: The agent asked if I was interested in the SIP plan
The agent asked are you interested
The agent told me about SIP
e: Interrogative (Yes/No) में 'if/whether' और 'are' बदलकर 'was' हो जाता है।

q: Sentence Rearrangement: P: digital banking Q: has revolutionized R: the traditional S: banking system
e: सही क्रम: 'Digital banking has revolutionized the traditional banking system' (PQRS)।

q: Sentence Rearrangement: P: for sustainable growth Q: financial inclusion R: is essential S: in any economy
e: सही क्रम: 'Financial inclusion is essential for sustainable growth in any economy' (QRSP)।

q: Select correctly spelt word:
e: सही स्पेलिंग 'Entrepreneur' (उद्यमी) है।

q: Synonym of 'REDUNDANT':
e: 'Redundant' का अर्थ है फालतू या जिसकी ज़रूरत न हो (Superfluous)।

q: Antonym of 'INSOLVENT':
e: 'Insolvent' (दिवालिया) का उल्टा 'Wealthy' (धनी) या 'Solvent' होगा।

q: Error Spotting: Either the (A) / manager or (B) / the employees (C) / is responsible for the error (D).
e: Proximity Rule: 'Either-or' में verb पास वाले subject (employees - Plural) के अनुसार 'are' होनी चाहिए।
